69f1a6a112d49c9cd5c2bf4498035e8e9bb511b4: Niederau is a small, low-key resort, with 24 km of runs offering an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and lift queues that barely exist. Niederau's reputation as a family resort is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for children to learn the basics of skiing. Niederau's moderate altitude, from 825 m at the base to 1560 m at the summit, makes it sensitive to weather variations. January and February remain the most reliable months for optimal snow cover. Outside that window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. A stay in Niederau is clearly expensive: a day lift pass costs 72€, on top of accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. That is the price of excellence, but it is worth knowing before you go. In short, Niederau doesn't compete with the giants of skiing and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest, often underrated destination that deserves to be (re)discovered.
